title: Exploring the efficacy of hybrid-sketch: an investigation into conceptual support in the early design stage

context_summary: This study investigates the effectiveness of synthetic-sketches generated via Cycle-GAN as conceptual support in early design. It compares synthetic-sketches with product renderings, focusing on design cognition and creativity.
